description: This Java class 'TraceUriGenerator' generates trace URIs based on input paths, aiming to minimize logged requests and prevent excessive trace creation. It uses regex patterns to parse and normalize paths, and handles special cases like messages and health status paths.

classes.name: TraceUriGenerator
classes.description: A final class implementing Function<String, TraceInformation> that generates trace URIs from paths, with regex-based path parsing and normalization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton factory method to create or return the existing instance of TraceUriGenerator with compiled regex pattern.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Generates TraceInformation from a given path, ensuring the path is not null.

methods.name: extractTraceInformation
methods.description: Parses and normalizes the path, matches against regex patterns, and constructs TraceInformation with appropriate tags.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes the input path by removing duplicate slashes, trimming trailing slashes, and adding a leading slash if missing.

methods.name: getMatcherValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific capturing group value from a matcher, returning an Optional.

methods.name: tryGetCapturingGroup
methods.description: Attempts to get a capturing group from a matcher, handling IllegalArgumentException.
